traits.name: fierce
traits.reason: Lines are curt but never sharply aimed at anyone who crossed her, and no mending after damage appears; only mild clipped phrasing like 'He left again.'

traits.name: loyal
traits.reason: She keeps calling Lagalong home, gives headings and counts, promises 'Bridge soon', and invites him with 'Come along!'; no arrival joy is shown yet.

traits.name: jealous
traits.reason: She says 'Jealous' in nearly every line, uses clipped lines about Lagalong leaving ('He left again. Building.'), and builds harder in response.

traits.name: vain
traits.reason: 'Bridge soon' hints at pride in her bridges, but there are no pleased mentions of her trail and no pretended indifference to discoveries.

traits.name: chime like
traits.reason: Lines run two to eight words, use compass headings with counts ('East six, past the water'), and add exclamations when bright.
